usage: belief_eval_scale.py [-h] [--size {large,medium,small}] [--seed SEED]
                            [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--keep] [--owner OWNER]
                            [--min-top5 MIN_TOP5] [--out OUT]

Fork: the belief ledger at scale (personal-context plan stage 2.5, "Measure").

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --size {large,medium,small}
                        small (30 subjects, 300 beliefs), medium (300, 3000;
                        default), large (1000, 10000)
  --seed SEED           corpus seed (default 7)
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   where to seed beliefs.db and memory.json (default: a
                        temp dir)
  --keep                keep the temp dir (an explicit --data-dir is always
                        kept)
  --owner OWNER         owner to seed (default 'scale-owner')
  --min-top5 MIN_TOP5   pass threshold for top-5 recall when retrieval runs
                        (default 0.9)
  --out OUT             results JSON (default
                        data/eval/belief_eval_scale.<size>.json, gitignored)
